newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Tech, Advanced Delivery to merge.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Tech, Advanced Delivery to merge.

text.p: Advanced Technology Materials Inc said Monday it has definitively agreed to merge with Advanced Delivery & Chemical Systems and related entities in a stock swap valued at $92 million.

Advanced Delivery would become a subsidiary of a new Advanced Technology holding company and about 5.5 million common shares of the company would be exchanged for the interests in Advanced Delivery, the company said.
Advanced Technology said it expects the acquisition to be accretive to 1997 earnings and that it would recognize costs of about $2 million in the period the deal closes.

Advanced Delivery makes and distributes ultra-high purity semiconductor thin film materials. The Austin, Texas-based company has about 60 employees and 1996 calendar-year revenues of more than $20 million. Its 1996 net income was was about $5 million, Advanced Technology said.

The company said the final number of shares exchanged will be determined upon shareholder approval. It said the deal would be accounted for as a "pooling of interests" and close by mid-year 1997 if all approvals and conditions are attained.
